description: Search active rental listings across all five NYC boroughs.

amenities.description: Amenity enums such as DISHWASHER, WASHER_DRYER, ELEVATOR, DOORMAN, LAUNDRY, GYM, POOL, PARKING.

areas.description: Area IDs (comma-separated string or array, at most 10). Borough IDs: Manhattan=100, Bronx=200, Brooklyn=300, Queens=400, Staten Island=500.

buildingType.description: Comma-separated: RENTAL, CONDO, CO_OP, CONDOP, HOUSE, SINGLEFAMILY, TOWNHOUSE, TWOFAMILY, THREEFAMILY, FOURFAMILY, MULTI_FAMILY, MIXED_USE, HYBRID, COMMERCIAL, UNKNOWN.

has3dTour.description: Only listings with a 3D tour. Accepts true or must be omitted.

hasOpenHouse.description: Only listings with an open house. Accepts true or must be omitted.

location.description: A single borough or neighborhood name.

noFee.description: Only no-fee rentals. Accepts true or must be omitted.

perPage.description: Results per page; default 3, max 5 upstream.

name: search_rentals
